label: TP
reason: Alert-TP: User-provided cookie value flows through URL decoding, becomes the `input` array, converts back to String, passes through `encodeForHTML()` (which encodes the hash bytes, not the user input), and finally concatenates directly into the `response.getWriter().println()` sink. The sink expression includes the raw decoded user input (`new String(input)`), bypassing protection. Resolved sink value depends on attacker control.

evidence.note: User cookie value -> decode -> input -> new String(input) -> encodedForHTML(hash) + new String(input) -> println sink
